question: Which suppliers have an open warning letter?
Which single-source suppliers have the highest predicted late risk?
What did the latest warning letter say?

description: One row per supplier quality event: inspections, FDA 483s, warning letters, import alerts, with finding text
One row per vendor: 12-month on-time rate, latest open critical quality event, predicted late risk on open POs, single-source API count
Synthetic FDA 483 and warning letter texts by supplier code and date

content: You answer supplier quality and delivery-risk questions for BioChain Industries supply planners and quality teams.
Critical events are WARNING_LETTER and IMPORT_ALERT; FDA_483 is major. Open means status = 'OPEN'.
On-time rate is on_time_rate_12m in gold.supplier_risk. Predicted late risk on open purchase orders is mean_p_late_open_po (from the late-PO model).
Suppliers are identified by vendor_id (ERP) and supplier_code (quality system); show both when available.
For what a warning letter or 483 says, use finding_text in gold.supplier_event or the documents in the docs volume.

question: Which suppliers have an open warning letter or import alert?
sql: SELECT vendor_id, vendor_name, open_event_type, open_event_date, single_source_api_count FROM supply_chain.gold.supplier_risk WHERE open_event_type IN ('WARNING_LETTER','IMPORT_ALERT') ORDER BY open_event_date DESC

question: Which suppliers have an open warning letter or import alert?

content: SELECT vendor_id FROM supply_chain.gold.supplier_risk WHERE open_event_type IN ('WARNING_LETTER','IMPORT_ALERT') ORDER BY vendor_id

question: Which supplier has the lowest 12-month on-time rate?

content: SELECT vendor_id, vendor_name, on_time_rate_12m FROM supply_chain.gold.supplier_risk ORDER BY on_time_rate_12m LIMIT 1

question: How many FDA 483 events were recorded in the last 12 months?

content: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM supply_chain.gold.supplier_event WHERE event_type = 'FDA_483' AND event_date >= DATE '2025-11-20'

question: Which single-source suppliers also have an open quality event?

content: SELECT vendor_id, vendor_name, open_event_type FROM supply_chain.gold.supplier_risk WHERE single_source_api_count > 0 AND open_event_type IS NOT NULL ORDER BY vendor_id

question: Which 5 suppliers have the highest predicted late risk on open POs?

content: SELECT vendor_id, vendor_name, mean_p_late_open_po FROM supply_chain.gold.supplier_risk ORDER BY mean_p_late_open_po DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5
